title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 新增了 Claude Managed Agents 权限策略的 auto 模式和 ant CLI 的 beta:sessions connect 功能，表明 Agent 管理能力增强。

added_lines: Claude Managed Agents permission policies now include auto: the server evaluates each agent or MCP tool call and runs it, denies it, or pauses for your approval. agent.tool_use and agent.mcp_tool_use events report how each call was evaluated in an evaluation field alongside evaluated_permission. See Let the server evaluate each call with auto.

The ant CLI adds ant beta:sessions connect, which attaches your terminal to a Claude Managed Agents session. You can follow the session live, send messages, and allow or deny tool calls that are waiting for approval. Pass --web to serve the Claude Console's session viewer locally and open the session there instead. See Connect to a Managed Agents session from your terminal.
